```python
# Standard-library-only finite grounding and preference-aware inference.
def atom(subject, predicate, obj="", positive=True):
    return (subject, predicate, obj, positive)

def opposite(a):
    return a[:3] + (not a[3],)

animals = (
    "bee", "badger", "frog", "snake", "seahorse", "vampire",
    "beaver", "ostrich", "dove", "woodpecker", "monkey", "swan",
    "rhino", "stork", "beetle", "goat", "ant", "dragon", "dinosaur",
    "flamingo", "finch", "pigeon", "fangtooth", "bison", "zebra",
    "dragonfly", "peafowl",
)

facts = {
    atom("bee", "card_color", "blue"),
    atom("bee", "tears_down_castle", "badger", False),
    atom("frog", "card_color", "yellow"),
    atom("frog", "has_vegetable", "spinach"),
    atom("snake", "reduced_work_hours"),
    atom("seahorse", "creates_castle", "vampire", False),
    # RGB is the specified primary-color convention.
    atom("red", "primary_color"),
    atom("green", "primary_color"),
    atom("blue", "primary_color"),
    atom("spinach", "leafy_green_vegetable"),
}

rules = []

def add(number, antecedents, conclusion):
    rules.append((number, frozenset(antecedents), conclusion))

for x in animals:
    add(1, [atom(x, "shouts", "beaver")],
        atom(x, "unites", "ostrich"))
    add(2, [atom(x, "tears_down_castle", "dove")],
        atom("woodpecker", "takes_over_emperor", "monkey"))
    add(3, [atom(x, "persuades", "rhino")],
        atom("swan", "shouts", "beaver", False))
    add(5, [atom(x, "tears_down_castle", "badger", False)],
        atom(x, "refuses_help", "badger"))
    add(6, [atom(x, "enjoys_companionship", "ant")],
        atom("swan", "shouts", "peafowl", False))
    add(7, [atom(x, "unites", "ostrich")],
        atom("beetle", "trades", "stork"))
    add(8, [atom(x, "creates_castle", "dragon")],
        atom(x, "refuses_help", "dinosaur"))
    add(10, [atom(x, "wants_to_see", "goat")],
        atom("finch", "captures_king", "pigeon", False))
    add(12, [atom(x, "creates_castle", "vampire", False)],
        atom(x, "enjoys_companionship", "ant"))
    add(13, [atom(x, "takes_over_emperor", "monkey")],
        atom("bee", "refuses_help", "dinosaur", False))
    add(14, [atom(x, "wants_to_see", "fangtooth")],
        atom(x, "shouts", "beetle", False))
    add(15, [atom(x, "trades", "bison")],
        atom("swan", "unites", "ostrich", False))
    add(17, [atom(x, "refuses_help", "dinosaur", False)],
        atom(x, "reveals_secret", "zebra"))
    add(18, [
        atom(x, "shouts", "beetle", False),
        atom(x, "reveals_secret", "zebra"),
    ], atom(x, "trades", "stork", False))
    add(19, [atom(x, "refuses_help", "badger")],
        atom(x, "shouts", "dragonfly"))
    add(20, [atom(x, "shouts", "dragonfly")],
        atom(x, "wants_to_see", "fangtooth"))
    add(22, [atom(x, "shouts", "peafowl")],
        atom(x, "shouts", "beaver"))

add(4, [
    atom("bee", "trades", "stork", False),
    atom("beetle", "trades", "stork"),
], atom("stork", "wants_to_see", "goat"))
add(9, [atom("flamingo", "smiles", "bee")],
    atom("bee", "shouts", "beetle"))
add(11, [atom("frog", "age_less_than_four")],
    atom("frog", "destroys_wall", "swan", False))

for color in ("red", "green", "blue", "yellow"):
    add(16, [
        atom("frog", "card_color", color),
        atom(color, "primary_color"),
    ], atom("frog", "destroys_wall", "swan", False))

add(21, [
    atom("frog", "has_vegetable", "spinach"),
    atom("spinach", "leafy_green_vegetable"),
], atom("frog", "destroys_wall", "swan"))
add(23, [atom("snake", "reduced_work_hours")],
    atom("snake", "tears_down_castle", "dove"))
add(24, [atom("frog", "destroys_wall", "swan")],
    atom("swan", "shouts", "peafowl"))

# (higher-priority rule, lower-priority rule)
preferences = {
    (11, 21), (15, 1), (16, 21), (24, 6),
    (3, 22), (8, 13), (9, 14),
}

def infer_step(known):
    applicable = [r for r in rules if r[1] <= known]
    conclusions = set(facts)
    for number, antecedents, head in applicable:
        defeated = any(
            (higher_number, number) in preferences
            and higher_head == opposite(head)
            for higher_number, _, higher_head in applicable
        )
        if not defeated:
            conclusions.add(head)
    return conclusions

known = set(facts)
seen = set()
for iteration in range(1000):
    signature = frozenset(known)
    if signature in seen:
        print("UNSUPPORTED: inference entered a non-stationary cycle")
        print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
        break
    seen.add(signature)
    updated = infer_step(known)
    if updated == known:
        positive = atom("finch", "captures_king", "pigeon")
        negative = opposite(positive)
        pos_proved = positive in known
        neg_proved = negative in known

        print("Finch captures pigeon king:", pos_proved)
        print("Finch does not capture pigeon king:", neg_proved)
        print("Stork wants to see goat:",
              atom("stork", "wants_to_see", "goat") in known)
        print("Bee does not trade with stork:",
              atom("bee", "trades", "stork", False) in known)
        print("Beetle trades with stork:",
              atom("beetle", "trades", "stork") in known)

        if pos_proved and neg_proved:
            print("UNSUPPORTED: both target polarities were derived")
            print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
        else:
            expected = (
                "proved" if pos_proved else
                "disproved" if neg_proved else
                "unknown"
            )
            print("Expected answer:", expected)
            print("Submitted answer: disproved")
            print("CHECK PASS" if expected == "disproved" else "CHECK FAIL")
        break
    known = updated
else:
    print("UNSUPPORTED: inference did not converge")
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
```
